data.long_meaning: She who is content, satisfied, or at peace. historical_references.reference: Raghda bint Al-Harith ibn Hisham (d. 622 CE) was a noblewoman of the Banu Mudar tribe in pre-Islamic Arabia. She is known for her beauty and her role in the early history of Islam.
